colour_palette.details: Plain white background with minimal color accents. The vibrant cultural fusion (El Paso Border + Jewish culture) is not expressed through the visual palette.

logo.details: Logo is embedded in the nav without SVG scaling or proper og:image social share fallback.

typography.details: No dedicated web fonts configured; copy relies on browser default fonts without structured typographic hierarchy for headlines or subheadings.

contact.details: Direct phone number, location, dedicated contact page with web form, and active social channels across Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram.

online_presence.details: Sparse WordPress layout with external Toast Tab ordering link. Missing structured Restaurant schema and open-graph images.

verdict.commercial_rationale: One of the most charismatic, storytelling-rich restaurant concepts in Austin ('Shalom y'all, Mucho gusto!'). Their food and brand voice are phenomenal, but their site is a sterile, basic WordPress shell.

sample_website.notes: Vibrant border-culture diner concept with animated latke burger visualizer.
